title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.325 - Added `archiveSession()` and `unarchiveSession()`, and an `archived` field on the sessions that `listSessions()` and `getSessionInfo()` return - Added `refuseIfBusy` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can have a reload refused while the session is busy - Added `managed_lock` to `plugin_errors` entries on `system/init`, naming the managed `enabledPlugins` entry that dropped a plugin copy - Added a `system/informational` warning, tagged `hook_no_verdict`, when a `PreToolUse` hook can't run or answer, or times out, without refusing its tool call - Added `invalid_config_file` to the `config_file_invalid` startup failure result: the broken config file's path and its backup's path as fields - Fixed deny rules (`disallowedTools`, `permissions.deny`, `always_deny`) that name an in-process SDK MCP tool or its server, or match it with a glob, leaving it in Claude's tool list and `system/init` - Fixed `supportedEffortLevels` in model info listing effort levels above the organization's effort cap or the `maxEffortLevel` setting - Changed the `sandbox` option: sandboxed Bash commands are no longer auto-approved unless `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true` is set
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
